name: Goldsmiths, University of London

settingEvidence.evidence: Based in vibrant New Cross, our friendly single-site campus is the perfect base to explore all that London has to offer.

fees.text: £9,790 per year for Home (UK) students on full-time undergraduate courses (the course pages say these are the fees for students starting in the 2026/2027 academic year; the 2027/28 fee is not published yet).

source.evidence: Home - full-time: £9790

livingCosts.text: Goldsmiths halls cost about £191.50–£404.50 a week in 2026/27 depending on the hall and room type, with electricity, water and heating bills included.

openDays.text: Next undergraduate open days (in person, 11am–3pm): 21 November 2026 and 5 December 2026. Subject-specific virtual events are still to be announced.

source.evidence: Undergraduate Open Day (In-person)

contextual.summary: Goldsmiths gives a contextual offer three grades lower than its published offer to care-experienced and estranged applicants, and gives other flagged applications extra consideration (no guaranteed offer).
contextual.typicalReduction: Three grades lower than the published requirement for care-experienced or estranged applicants (a typical A-level offer of CCC would be reduced to DDD); students on a Progression Agreement can get offers one grade lower than advertised.

criteria.detail: Care experienced: time in residential care, foster care or kinship care (formal or informal) or as an unaccompanied asylum seeker. Answer yes to the care-experienced question on your UCAS application. Goldsmiths sets no limit on how long you were in care and no age limit.

Estranged: no contact with your parents during your studies, or very limited contact where you still have a relationship with your siblings. Answer yes to the estranged question on your UCAS application. Goldsmiths sets no limit on how long you were estranged and no age limit.

Progression Agreements (local and mature students): students on agreements with Goldsmiths' local partner colleges (the page names Lewisham College, Southwark College and Mulberry UTC) or studying an OCN or LASER Access to HE Diploma can access guaranteed interviews and/or offers one grade lower than advertised on more than 50 undergraduate programmes. The 2027-entry documents are being refreshed.

contextual.rulesText: If you answer yes to either the care experienced or estranged questions on your UCAS application, Goldsmiths will automatically consider you for a reduced grade offer (three grades lower than the published requirement; the exact offer depends on the programme and qualification). Other applications flagged through the UCAS contextual questions, or by information from you or your referee, get extra consideration beyond the usual checks, which does not guarantee an offer.

source.evidence: If you answer yes to either the care experienced or estranged questions on your UCAS application, we will automatically consider you for a reduced grade offer.

programmes.name: Discover Gold Days
programmes.summary: Campus visit days for Year 12 and 13 students with a campus tour, a workshop about university, a free lunch, a Q&A with student ambassadors and an academic taster session.
programmes.whoCanApply: School and college groups and individual prospective students in Years 12 and 13. Places go first to schools and colleges in South East London and to students from underrepresented groups, such as those entitled to Free School Meals (Pupil Premium).
programmes.eligibilityDetail: Open to groups and individual prospective students, but when assigning places Goldsmiths prioritises schools and colleges in South East London and students from underrepresented groups, such as those entitled to Free School Meals (Pupil Premium students).
benefits: Campus tour led by student ambassadors
Workshop about university and an academic taster session
Free lunch in the campus refectory
programmes.infoNote: The page says Discover Gold Days run throughout the year but gives no dates, booking window or deadline for 2027.

source.evidence: The Widening Participation Team runs Discover Gold Days throughout the year for school and college groups and individual prospective students.

notConfirmed: dates, booking window and deadline for 2027 are not published
cost: the page says lunch is free but not whether the visit itself is free
